content_text:
Hello! I had a quick question for anyone who has an answer! Mr Deakins with your wooden ringlights you typically inlay the sockets into the ring. Looking at BTS footage however the wiring for them seems to be on the front. Did I get this wrong? Is the wiring on the back? I know you typically mount these rings to chandelier mounts in locations. does it have something to do with not getting in the way of the mounting? It just feels like more work to inlay the sockets and then send the wires back through to the front.
Thank you in advance!
